HOLD FOR CURRENT-MAIN SUCCESSOR — exact 686e227053a677735b85462b0dab9197dfb3df38 is clean as a standalone change, but the posted drift conclusion is stale against current main.

TYPE-DISCIPLINE RESULT ON EXACT 686e227: Clean, zero findings. The two test-only changes preserve the construction-boundary plan: one positive control uses the exact Mirror summon syntax, the second uses the exact direct companion fromProduct syntax, and the four CellCoordinates negatives remain separate. The explicit test-only fromProduct is proof scaffolding, not public library API or a new construction door in production. No suppressor, cast, wildcard, partial runtime path, weakened type, sentinel, or should-have-changed production site appears in the diff. Cold detached clone at exact 686e227, after alignJVM/clean, passed CellCoordinatesUnforgeableSuite 2 of 2 and scalafmtCheckAll. Exact file SHA-256 values are suite 6e67b071... and control 2cfcccd7.... The reported mutation evidence is directionally sufficient, and the equal aggregate test count is correctly not claimed as a change detector.

CURRENT-MAIN CONTRADICTION: main is now a8d989a68fa8b0626c707456805a0b09eaadf37e. Both a00fc307 and 686e227 have merge base eced9f066e12e8d9e1ed5999b812b20c195f09c6 with current main; the symmetric difference is 2 commits on the candidate side and 26 on main. Neither candidate parent nor candidate is an ancestor of main. More importantly, this is semantic overlap in the exact court: current main deletes ProbeCartesianControl.scala and uses production CostBreakdown as the Mirror positive control. Applying the exact a00fc-to-686e patch to current main fails at CellCoordinatesUnforgeableSuite line 40 and because ProbeCartesianControl.scala is absent.

Therefore rebase or a consolidated current-main successor is REQUIRED FOR CORRECTNESS, not tidiness. It must restore the test-owned Mirror control plus the explicit same-syntax companion control on a current-main parent, then rerun clean macro-sensitive courts and the declared gate. The original 686e evidence remains valid only for the standalone object. No bead, candidate, authorization, or landing action exists or is inferred here.
